name: Craiyon
tagline: Craiyon (formerly DALL-E mini) is a free, browser-based AI image generator that turns text prompts into images instantly with no sign-up required. While output quality is lower than premium tools, its zero-friction access makes it the go-to for quick idea generation and meme creation.
